ios.desc:
Ever wish tracking your mood didn't feel like homework? VibeJar is the beautifully simple mood tracker that gets out of your way, and reflects how you feel.

ONE TAP. THAT'S IT. 

No justification. No endless questions. Just select how you're feeling, and you're done in one second. Add an optional note if you want, or don't, it's upto you. 

---
THE APP THAT FEELS LIKE YOU 

With its vibrant dynamic themes, VibeJar completely transforms to reflect your current mood. Feeling happy? Every screen, every button, every animation celebrates with you. Feeling down? The app softens into warm, comforting tones, a gentle companion when you need it the most. 

---
UNDERSTAND YOUR EMOTIONAL PATTERNS

See your mood history at a glance with beautiful visualizations:

• Color-coded calendar showing every day's mood
• Charts revealing weekly, monthly, and yearly trends
• Spot patterns you never noticed before

---
WORKS EVERYWHERE, ALWAYS

• Fully offline, works on planes, in basements, anywhere (except login)
• Blazing fast (no waiting for servers)
• Reliable syncing when you enable it
• Supports phone and tablet

---
YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS. PERIOD.

No tracking. No data mining. Just you and your moods. Your mood data will never be used to profile you, nor will it ever be shared with any third party for any purposes. 

---
DESIGNED TO DELIGHT

We believe mental wellness tools should feel good to use. 

VibeJar features:
• Modern, premium design that adapts to your mood
• Smooth animations and delightful interactions
• Simple and clean interface with zero clutter

---
GENTLE REMINDERS (OPTIONAL)

Set daily reminders to check in with yourself—or don't. We'll never nag you. Notifications are respectful, customizable, and easy to disable.

---
WHO IS VIBEJAR FOR?

VibeJar is perfect if you:

• Don't have time for lengthy journaling sessions
• Want a mood tracker that feels personal, not clinical
• Struggle with feature-heavy apps that overwhelm you
• Want to understand your emotional patterns without complexity
• Appreciate beautiful design in your daily tools


---
WHAT MAKES VIBEJAR DIFFERENT?

Most mood trackers are either too complex (endless features you'll never use) or too clinical (feels like a medical device). VibeJar is the Goldilocks solution: simple enough for daily use, insightful enough to help you understand yourself, and beautiful enough to make you smile.
